title: Crypto giant Binance hit by 'largest hack in history'

claims.claim: Binance said on Thursday that $6.3bn of digital assets have been impacted by a hack.

evidence.quote: Cryptocurrency giant Binance said on Thursday that $6.3bn (Â£4.7bn) of digital assets have been impacted by what has been described as the "largest hack in history".

claims.claim: Binance stated that about half of the impacted assets have been frozen with the help of other platforms.

evidence.quote: The world's biggest crypto exchange said about half of those assets have been frozen with the help of other platforms
The world's biggest crypto exchange said about half of those assets have been frozen with the help of other platforms, adding that it will "cover all losses".

claims.claim: Early checks show the incident may have involved a compromised engineer's laptop.

evidence.quote: Early checks show the incident may have involved an engineer's laptop that had been compromised
Early checks show the incident may have involved an engineer's laptop that had been compromised, which allowed an attacker to make unauthorised withdrawals, Binance said.

claims.claim: Analytics firms attributed the incident to a North Korean hacking unit called TraderTraitor.

evidence.quote: Two analytics firms have attributed the incident, which eclipses a record-setting $1.5bn hack on the Bybit exchange in 2025, to a North Korean hacking unit called TraderTraitor.

claims.claim: Binance.US stated that its platform is not affected by the issue.

evidence.quote: The incident concerns Binance.com - while much smaller crypto platform Binance.US, which provides trading services specifically for American residents - said its platform is not affected by the issue.

claims.claim: Tether and Circle said they have frozen a total of about $2.4bn of assets in response to the Binance hack.

evidence.quote: Two other major crypto platforms, Tether and Circle, said they have frozen a total of about $2.4bn of assets in response to the potential Binance hack.

claims.claim: Binance was founded in China in 2017 and has more than 300 million registered users worldwide.

evidence.quote: Binance, which was founded in China in 2017, allows users to trade digital assets and is estimated to have more than 300 million registered users worldwide.

claims.claim: Bitcoin dropped by more than 4% following the alerts about the hack.

evidence.quote: Bitcoin dropped by more than 4% following the alerts.
